world.title: Navi Pillay, former UN human rights chief, wins Nobel Peace Prize
world.description: Pillay is recognised for her "efforts to promote peace and international law", the Norwegian Nobel Committee says.

world.title: Firing squad execution to be livestreamed, Pentagon says

world.title: Fort Hood survivor supports gunman's execution by firing squad but questions livestream
world.description: Alonzo Lunsford tells the BBC the punishment befits the crime but he has some doubts whether the public should be able to watch it.

world.title: France promises 3,000 extra teachers in first step to calm student protests
world.description: Education minister Edouard Geffray makes the offer after another day of sometimes violent demonstrations by high-school students.

world.title: Crazy Rich Asians to return as TV show with original film's stars

world.title: Doctor accused of 1994 Rwanda genocide offences to face trial in UK
world.description: Dr Vincent Brown was allegedly a "leader" or "supervisor" of violent acts carried out by others in the early days of the genocide.

world.title: Three Saudi nationals killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
world.description: The missile attacks come amid an escalation in fighting between the Iran-backed group and Saudi Arabia, which backs Yemen's government.
